text: uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo yo sotassa .pe. yo ghānassa . yo jivhāya . yo kāyassa . yo manassa uppādo ṭhiti abhinibbatti pātubhāvo dukkhasseso uppādo rogānaṃ ṭhiti jarāmaraṇassa pātubhāvo . yo ca kho bhikkhave cakkhussa nirodho vūpasamo atthaṅgamo dukkhasseso nirodho rogānaṃ vūpasamo jarāmaraṇassa atthaṅgamo . yo sotassa . yo ghānassa . yo jivhāya . yo kāyassa . yo manassa nirodho
